name: Ostia

categories.label: Building/ship icons and amphora tokens
categories.labelVi: Biểu tượng công trình/tàu và amphora
categories.hint: VP per building/ship icon and per amphora depend on your reward cube position on the reward track (board table). Enter icon counts and the VP values read from the table.

categories.label: Destination tiles end-of-game effects
categories.labelVi: Hiệu ứng cuối game của ô điểm đến
categories.hint: Sum VP from the side of each destination tile your corbita tokens reached.

categories.label: Trading port tiles end-of-game effects
categories.labelVi: Hiệu ứng cuối game của cảng thương mại
categories.hint: Sum VP from trading port tiles where your construction discs sit (icon-only tiles excluded).

categories.label: Sets of 4 different icons
categories.hint: 8 VP per set of wild animal + exotic animal + nobleman + noblewoman.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. The reward-track VP table is printed on the board and was not available, so per-icon values are scorer inputs. Some trading port/destination effects add extra VP per icon type and are folded into the repeating categories. Solo mode not checked. Text taken from the RulesPal rulebook reproduction, not the official PDF.
